Park Plaza Victoria Amsterdam is located in the heart of the city, directly opposite Amsterdam Central Station. Combining historic architecture with contemporary comfort, the hotel welcomes both leisure and business guests from around the world.

As a Front Office Intern, you will be the face of the hotel and play a key role in creating memorable guest experiences. You will gain hands-on experience in all aspects of Front Office operations while developing your professional and hospitality skills in a dynamic international environment.

Responsibilities

• Communicate effectively with colleagues and guests, contributing to a positive team environment and consistent service delivery

• Support the guest journey, including check-ins, check-outs, and handling guest requests across phone, written, and face-to-face communication

• Assist with reservations, payments, and Front Office administrative tasks

• Deliver excellent guest service and respond professionally to guest enquiries

• Maintain a professional and welcoming Front Office environment in line with brand standards

• Collaborate with departments such as Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, and Maintenance to ensure smooth daily operations

• Learn and apply hotel procedures, standards, and systems to support operational excellence

Essential Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a hospitality or related study program

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Proactive attitude with willingness to learn and develop

• Guest-focused mindset with a positive and professional approach

• Enjoys working in a team and adapting to a fast-paced environment

• Available for an internship of at least 5-6 months

• Eligible to complete an internship in the

Are you a machine operator who likes to work in a cleanroom? Then read on! Wie zoeken we? Do you recognize yourself in the points below? Then you might be the machine operator we are looking for: Have an affinity with technology and are willing to delve deeper into the advanced machinery You don't mind working in a cleanroom Works accurately and has a great sense of quality Fluent in the English language, spoken and written. Speaking the Dutch language is a very big plus Wat bieden wij je? As a machine operator you can count on a challenging job in a great international and innovative company. In addition, you can expect the following in this job. A starting salary of at least €3,000 gross per month including shift allowance Interesting job for 36 hours in 2 shifts; Once every 2 weeks you are free on Friday Benefits such as: fresh fruit at work and several company outings per year Functieomschrijving Our relationship is an international company with a Dutch touch. They are a major player in the production of packaging for pharmaceutical products. This innovative company operates every day in modern cleanrooms and with a new machine park. Our relationship is growing fast. As a machine operator, will you help realize this growth? As a machine operator, you ensure that the packaging is printed correctly and has the correct dimensions. In addition, your activities as a machine operator include: Working in a cleanroom Working with various modern printing machines Pursuing set norms and standards according to ISO 13485 and GMP Ensures continuous high quality and signals when the products do not meet set requirements Rebuilds machines and fixes minor faults Do you see yourself performing this diverse role? Nice! We look forward to receiving your application. If you have any questions about this vacancy, you can contact colleagues in Venray by telephone on 088-6660790.
